$comment: QR-compatible metadata payload schema — TriadicFrameworks RTT/codes module. Refreshed 2026-05-06 to add metadata blocks and align with module migration.
title: RTTcode Payload Schema
description: A QR-compatible metadata payload for RTTcodes within the TriadicFrameworks ecosystem.

_meta.author: Nawder Loswin
_meta.relationship_note: This schema defines the QR-compatible payload format. The canonical packet schema at /docs/schemas/rttcode.v1.json defines the full RTTcode packet structure (tick, entities, environment, intent). Both schemas serve the RTT/codes module but operate at different levels of abstraction.

_session_context.modules: schema → validators → generators → style → examples → domain payloads

_version_history.note: Initial QR payload schema. Module home at /docs/rttcodes/.

Metadata refresh. Added $id, _meta, _session_context, _version_history. Module home migrated to /docs/rtt/codes/. Domain enum includes 'simulation' (not present in canonical _domains — intentional for payload-level classification). All property schemas unchanged.

domain.description: The RTT domain this artifact belongs to.

artifact_type.description: The type of artifact this RTTcode identifies.

version.description: Version identifier for the artifact (semantic or freeform).

tau_R.description: Memory time or coherence time descriptor.

Q_R.description: Quality factor or resonance depth descriptor.

checksum.description: Optional integrity checksum for the artifact.
